text:
Maya Nguyen: flagging sharp usage drop for CedarHealth — daily token usage down ~47% WoW, last healthy spike 2026-03-10. Procurement lead changed last week to J. Morales and we see a competitor pilot in their notes: https://redwood.app/customer/cedarhealth/pilot :warning:

Ethan Park: ouch. MRR exposure?

Maya Nguyen: ~ $38k ARR, renewal ~7 weeks out. 12 of 50 seats inactive >14 days. Quick metrics: https://redwood.app/metrics/cedarhealth/usage (private link)

Samir Patel: can we propose a short dedicated pilot (2w) or extend existing trial? idea: spin a dedicated pilot pool with reserved QPS and a promo to win back procurement interest.

Lina Torres: pls no unilateral infra promises. recommended immediate plan: 1) outreach to new procurement lead to capture concerns 2) propose 2-week pilot extension + 2-week SE enablement 3) attach usage snapshot + 3 short win scenarios

Ethan Park: i'll reach out to J. Morales today — will ask what's driving the competitor eval. Maya, can you prep the 3-bullet wins + usage snapshot?

Maya Nguyen: on it. Draft by EOD. @Samir can you prep an enablement playbook snippet we can attach?

Samir Patel: ack. Also can offer 30% off dedicated pilot pricing for the trial window.

Maya Nguyen: quick runbook snippet to attach:
```
Runbook: cedar-pilot-extend
- enable 10 demo seats
- reserved qps: 100
- promo: 30% off pilot pricing
- support: se-oncall@redwood.com
```

Samir Patel: adding config details now. ETA Fri 12:00 PT.

engagement-bot: EMERGING_SIGNAL: usage_drop=47% | seats_inactive=12 | renewal_in_days=49 | competitive_pilot=detected :eyes:

Lina Torres: scheduling suggestion — customer + procurement + Ethan + Maya + Samir on Wed 10:00 AM PT. Ethan pls confirm. Also I'll draft the success plan template to send post-call.

Ethan Park: Wed 10:00 AM PT works for me. i'll own procurement intro.

Maya Nguyen: recap / owners: Ethan = procurement outreach & meeting lead; Samir = pilot infra & promo; Lina = scheduling + success plan; Maya = deck & usage snapshot. Follow-up sync Fri 9:00 AM PT to check readiness.

Samir Patel: started infra prep, will post config link when ready.

Maya Nguyen: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update thread after procurement call.
